paragraphs.text: Repository code maps and navigation for DSH
# dsh-compass
DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 plugin. Node >=24; developed and tested locally with Node 26 / TypeScript 5.9.3. Rele
ase CI is configured for Node 24; that CI run is separate from local verification.
## Install from a GitHub Release
After a release is published, install its built archive into your DSH profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The release URL is the expected v0.1.0 asset location, not a claim that it has already been publishe
d. Use the archive and SHA256SUMS attached to the same GitHub Release. The package includes a DSH bu
ndle patch and built JavaScript; no Pi dependency is needed. Restart DSH after installation. Substit
ute your existing profile for `headless` if needed.
## Configuration
The default bundle config is `{}`: each tool uses the invoking agent's working directory. A host cal
l without an agent requires an explicit `root`. To pin a host-local workspace, add an override in yo
ur profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The root must already exist. It is interpreted on the DSH host, using Node filesystem APIs. A remote
DSH world or sandbox does not redirect these operations: only enable this plugin for a host-local p
roject. This is not a remote-world adapter or a security sandbox.
## Tools and examples
- `codebase_map({})` returns `files`, `packages` (JSON-encoded package summaries), candidate `entryP

oints`, `revision`, canonical `root` and `truncated`.
- `codebase_map({expectedRevision:"<previous r

evision>"})` rejects a stale map.
- `code_tour({topic:"auth",expectedRevision:"<map revision>"})` re
turns declaration lines from supported source files whose path contains `auth` literally, ignoring c
ase. Results include path and line number, and the map revision.
Ask DSH: “Map this repository, then show a tour of files under src.” Package metadata reports Node p
ackage names, scripts, and dependency names; scripts are never run. Candidate entry points include i
ndex/main/app/server files and Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml and go.mod. Candidates are heuristics, not
proven executable entry points.
## Limits and behavior
Every call scans fresh host-local files. Hidden entries, symlinks, node_modules, dist, build, target
, coverage and vendor directories are skipped. Scans stop at 1,000 files, 4,000 visited entries, or
directory depth eight and report truncation. This is not a Git-ignore parser. Malformed/unreadable p
ackage.json fails the operation instead of silently inventing package data. Reads reject traversal a
nd symlink ancestors and are bounded to 256 KiB per file.
Map revisions fingerprint file paths, size, mtime/ctime and package.json text; they are not a conten
t hash of every source file or an atomic filesystem snapshot. A tour verifies the map again after re
ading and asks for retry if it changed. It visits at most 20 matching files, returning up to 15 decl
aration lines per file (240 characters per line), and marks excess candidate files as truncated. Inv
alid UTF-8, binary, oversized or unreadable selected files fail explicitly.
Supported declaration heuristics cover common JS/TS, Python, Rust, Go, Java and C-family extensions.
This is not an AST index, reference search, import graph or compiler. Tours do not infer architectu
re. There is no persistent cache, automatic prompt injection, Pi TUI onboarding menu, framework/conv
ention detection or semantic tour generation. Concurrent reads are supported; disposal aborts/drains
work and unregisters tools.
## Filesystem boundary and verification
Path checks reject ordinary symlink redirection; regular-file opens use no-follow flags and inode ch
ecks, bounded reads and cancellation. These checks are not a sandbox against a malicious process con
currently replacing ancestor directories; use a trusted local workspace. Linux/macOS-style filesyste
m semantics are the intended target; Windows behavior has not been verified.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The suite uses real Cordis, DSH ToolRuntime, agent-loop and an offline scripted model; it verifies a
ctual model tool dispatch and results in the following model request, plus limits, revision/path che
cks, cancellation and unregistration. It requires no live model credentials. `check` includes TypeSc
ript checks for source/tests, behavior tests and a build. See UPSTREAM.md for pinned source and migr
ation differences and NOTICE for upstream MIT attribution.
